notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
[b]River Legends: A Fly Fishing Adventure[/b] will be releasing on [b]Tuesday, August 27, 2019[/b]. Are you ready for the first pixel art fly fishing game? Wishlist today and be among the first to play River Legends once it releases!

Here's a new gameplay GIF to get you ready!
